name: Social Media Agent
description: Agent that reads a URL and drafts Twitter and LinkedIn posts, with human review before publishing.
whatItDoes: Sources content from a link, writes posts for X and LinkedIn and schedules them after a person approves or edits the draft. It is for marketing and developer-relations teams.
howItWorks: A LangGraph graph scrapes the page with Firecrawl, generates a post with Claude and pauses for human-in-the-loop review, which also covers platform authentication. It runs on a local LangGraph server and is triggered by a script; the full setup adds Supabase, Slack and direct social API credentials.
